retrieval_scope: local source review only; no cloud resource retrieval, no account call, no order placed, cancelled or modified, no account paused or resumed, no schedule and no cloud configuration change
binding_policy: Reject null, missing or mismatched runtime bindings; freeze release-specific Forward templates; no historical child pin claim.
self_hash_policy: The manifest does not hash itself; offline evaluation reports its raw SHA-256 separately.
release_blockers: Unbound frozen Forward template versions/hashes, identities, environments and Vaults
Unbound exact cloud skill versions/content hashes and packaging hashes
Unverified effective Session configuration attestation and platform role/read-only isolation
Unverified MCP schemas, paper account/mode semantics and fresh short-borrow evidence
Unverified always_ask raw-payload permission interception and trusted relay enforcement
Unverified stable fill IDs, complete pagination, partial-fill/cancel semantics and actual fees
Unverified DAY time-in-force and submission idempotency (paper input schema exposes no TIF field; text is not an idempotency key)
Main deterministic R0-R21 and additional gate unit tests not evidenced by this spec checker
Durable relay journal, account fencing, approval consumption and kill recovery not deployed or proven
Four actual cloud prompt evaluations with reviewed diff and new Sessions not run
Full US-session shadow and separately approved 5322438 entry and reduce-only exit roundtrips with fills/fees/PnL/kill recovery not evidenced
Competition account 5832812 activation requires separate approval after all evidence gates

P* target provenance is only as good as one `research/r10_deploy.py live` run: its data refresh (Alpaca bars and SEC 8-K dates) has never been executed against a network or broker in this release, because every test injects a runner and no account or cloud call was authorized

Pre-trade ETF and short eligibility is verified against a supplied eligibility table, never against live broker quotes, borrow or fund-size data; the skipped-name deviation path has therefore not been observed on a real book

The `dashboard/` UI renders a fictional demo fixture (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA longs) that is not the P* book, so its numbers must never be read as strategy output; the four strategy-specific `skills/*/SKILL.md` playbooks are retargeted at P* in revision 0.3.3 and `skills/reconcile-paper-fills/SKILL.md` is strategy-neutral

The Slack `PAUSE`/`RESUME` listener is not implemented and the cloud agent that is to run the 2026-11-27 final exit on a schedule does not exist yet, so the switch the 2026-11-21 decision made the only human control is currently a CLI command and a journal row, not something the user can send from a phone

Automatic execution removes the typed approval from the send path and replaces it with the deterministic gate plus the pause switch, so a run that submits the whole `plan` list is only as safe as `plan.json`, the 300-second quote and snapshot freshness window, and the reprice-round ceiling

The 2026-11-19 competition book is entered one session late under a single dated R10 exception (day 2026-11-23, `decided_by` user 2026-11-21) that has never been exercised at a broker; no other day is allowed to reuse it

The 1-7 moomoo order status-code enumeration is documentation-derived knowledge carried in the 2026-11-21 instruction, not machine-verified: the MCP metadata for sim_trade_history_order_list publishes request fields only, and of the seven codes only 4 and 5 have been observed, in the 2026-11-20 history of 5322438. Code 0, any further undocumented code, and whether a cancelled-with-no-fill order reprices cleanly, have not been observed on a real book
